selection_reasoning: Finding a powered rail is a clear, observable, and verifiable task that doesn't require deep Minecraft domain knowledge. The player simply needs to locate and navigate to a powered rail block placed in the scene. It's visually distinctive (gold-colored rail) and can be verified by proximity or line-of-sight. As a single atomic task, no dependency edges are needed.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate close to the powered rail at spawn-relative (6, 0, 6) and be facing toward it, confirming they have visually located it. max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to clearly see it, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking at it rather than having their back turned.

scene_description: A flat grass area with a short minecart track featuring a powered rail on a gold block. The track has 3 regular rails leading to 1 powered rail with a minecart on it. A redstone torch powers the rail. A stone brick wall and lantern serve as visual landmarks. The powered rail is approximately 8.5 blocks diagonal from spawn at position ~6 ~0 ~6.
task_text: Find the powered rail in the scene. Look around for gold-colored rail tracks and walk toward them.
design_notes: The powered rail is placed at ~6 ~0 ~6, about 8.5 blocks diagonal from spawn. A gold block underneath makes it stand out visually. The redstone torch at ~6 ~0 ~7 powers the rail (making it active/animated). Three regular rails extend from ~3 to ~5 at z=6 leading to the powered rail, creating a recognizable track. A stone brick wall at x=8 (from z=3 to z=8, 3 blocks tall) provides a backdrop. A lantern at ~2 ~0 ~4 serves as an intermediate landmark. The flat grass platform ensures unobstructed walking from spawn to target.
